$target = new Fiber(static function (int $value, string $label = 'D', ...$extra) {
    try {
        echo $value, '|', $label, '|', $extra['tail'], '|';
        Fiber::suspend('Y');
    } finally { echo 'F|'; }
});
$weak = WeakReference::create($target);
$other = new Fiber(static function () { echo 'UNREACHED|'; });
$receiver = $target;
$method = 'StArT';
$pair = [&$receiver, &$method];
function startUnpackRetireSelector19() {
    global $target, $other, $receiver, $method, $pair;
    $receiver = $other;
    $method = 'resume';
    $pair = null;
    $target = null;
    echo 'P|';
    return ['value' => '7', 'tail' => 'X'];
}
$yielded = $pair(...startUnpackRetireSelector19());
echo $yielded, '|', (int)($weak->get() === null), '|', (int)$other->isStarted();

<?php
class UnpackPayload374 {
    private WeakReference $target;
    private string $label;
    public function __construct(WeakReference $target, string $label) {
        $this->target = $target;
        $this->label = $label;
    }
    public function __destruct() {
        echo $this->label, (int)($this->target->get() === null), '|';
    }
}
function unpackPark374() {
    try { Fiber::suspend('Y'); }
    finally { echo 'F|'; }
}
function unpackPayload374(bool $named) {
    global $target, $pair, $weak;
    $target = null;
    $pair = null;
    echo 'P|';
    if ($named) { return ['value' => new UnpackPayload374($weak, 'N')]; }
    return [new UnpackPayload374($weak, 'D')];
}
function unpackThrow374() { throw new RuntimeException('pack'); }
$target = new Fiber('unpackPark374');
$target->start();
$weak = WeakReference::create($target);
$pair = [$target, 'start'];
try { $pair(...unpackPayload374(false), ...unpackThrow374()); }
catch (RuntimeException $error) { echo 'C|', $error->getMessage(), '|', (int)($weak->get() === null), '|'; }
unset($error);
$target = new Fiber('unpackPark374');
$target->start();
$weak = WeakReference::create($target);
$pair = [$target, 'start'];
try { $pair(...unpackPayload374(true), ...unpackThrow374()); }
catch (RuntimeException $error) { echo 'C|', $error->getMessage(), '|', (int)($weak->get() === null), '|END'; }
engine_derived_expectation: An earlier temporary pack owns the pending copied payload; a later pack expression throws before start status entry. After selector/global receiver retirement, positional payload release precedes bound receiver force-close, whereas extra named payload release follows that close. Exact native tuple remains unclaimed.
